description: This is a PHP class file defining the COD (Cash on Delivery) payment method for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It contains a class that extends the base Model class, with a method to determine the available payment methods based on the customer's address and configuration settings.

classes.name: COD
classes.description: Represents the Cash on Delivery payment method in OpenCart. It determines whether the COD option should be available based on various conditions such as customer address, subscription status, and configuration settings.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Returns the available payment method data for COD if it is applicable based on the customer's address and platform configuration.
